note.text: Per the ODE/360X adapter pattern (lp-digitalhealth/ode-360x-adapter): this Task has been updated from 'requested'/'received' (Interaction 1) to 'in-progress'/'interim-results' following Penn Dental's dental exam on 2026-07-23. This update was generated by Penn Dental's PMS and transmitted outbound through the bridge as an IHE PCC-59 (Interim Consultation Note) back to FCCC's EHR — the first reverse-direction (PMS → bridge → EHR) transaction in this use case. PCC-59 HL7v2 artifact not yet built; flagged as a gap in interactions/README.md. The DDC inquiry was placed on 2026-07-23; response (52 Gy, exceeding 45 Gy osteoradionecrosis-risk threshold) was received on 2026-07-25. The dose data is recorded in Observation/observation-tooth30-radiation-dose, which is not included in Task.output because it was not produced by this 360X transaction — it arrived separately via the COW IG 'Requesting additional information' pattern. Final clearance will close this loop as a PCC-57 transaction (see Interaction 3 or later).
